headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 23, 2026**
article:
The MLB season continues to heat up with several exciting matchups and roster moves. Here's a look at the top news, injuries, and trades from around the league.

Top News
The New York Yankees suffered a 3-5 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Amed Rosario leading the Yankees' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. Framber Valdez earned the win for the Tigers with 6 strong innings, striking out 8 batters. The Kansas City Royals edged out the Tampa Bay Rays 2-1, with Michael Wacha pitching 7.0 innings and allowing just 1 ER. Alex Lange secured the save in the win. The Texas Rangers took a 4-3 win over the Miami Marlins behind Kumar Rocker's 5 shutout innings and Ezequiel Duran's 2 RBI, including a solo home run. The Washington Nationals secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Foster Griffin pitching 7.1 innings and allowing just 1 earned run. Curtis Mead led the Phillies' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. The Houston Astros outlasted the Toronto Blue Jays in a thrilling 9-7 victory, with multiple players contributing to the team's success. The Seattle Mariners secured a narrow win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with a final score of 3-2.

Injuries and Availability Impact
The Kansas City Royals placed 3B Maikel Garcia on the 10-day injured list due to a left hand muscle strain. The Detroit Tigers transferred RHP Burch Smith from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Colorado Rockies placed RHP Blas Castaño on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 18, 2026, due to a right pectoral strain. The Miami Marlins transferred RHP Josh Ekness from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right calf strain. The Miami Marlins placed C Liam Hicks on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 20, 2026, due to a low back strain. The Athletics transferred RHP Luis Severino from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. The Texas Rangers placed RHP Jack Leiter on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 19, 2026, due to a right ankle posterior impingement. The Baltimore Orioles placed C Adley Rutschman on the 7-day injured list retroactive to June 19, 2026, due to a concussion.

Trades and Roster Movement
The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later. The Washington Nationals traded SS Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash. The Washington Nationals also traded RHP Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Houston Astros traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.
